summary: Wallbox N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting Q2 2026 financial results, including revenue of €23.9 million, gross margin of 38.0%, and an operating loss of €11.0 million. The filing also notes completion of a financial restructuring involving a €15.8 million equity raise and €5.4 million in additional bank financing. This is a routine earnings release and business update, not a special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The restructuring mention is a completed balance-sheet strengthening, not an ongoing distressed restructuring. No deal terms, premiums, or board recommendations are provided.
